metaTitle: Pressure Washing Advertising: Google Ads and Facebook
metaDescription: Pressure washing advertising from ASP: Google Search Ads by service, before-and-after Facebook video and a Business Profile, all tracked to booked jobs.

hero.subhead: Search Ads and Facebook ads for house washing, roof cleaning and driveways, tracked to booked jobs where your CRM allows. Google's LSA list had no pressure washing category in October 2026.
points: An ad group for every service
Before-and-after video in feeds and Reels
Your accounts, your history, no exit fee

why.heading: Why paid search carries pressure washing
why.intro: With no Local Services Ads category as of October 2026, Google Search Ads do the job of reaching people already looking. Facebook then shows your results to homeowners before they need you.

cards.title: No category to lean on
cards.body: When Google's full US list was checked on October 15, 2026, it had no pressure washing or power washing category. We recheck it and don't assume a nearby category fits.

cards.title: Search terms read on schedule
cards.body: The search terms report shows what people typed to trigger your ads. It's the cheapest win in most accounts and the most skipped, so we read it regularly.

cards.title: Your results make the creative
cards.body: Pressure washing is a visual job. Vertical video shot as vertical video outperforms cropped landscape footage in feeds and Reels, so we plan before-and-after clips that way.

services.heading: Pressure washing ad channels ASP runs

cards.title: Google Search Ads
cards.body: Separate ad groups for house washing, roof cleaning, driveways and decks, with negatives that keep out equipment rentals and how-to searches.

cards.title: Facebook and Instagram ads
cards.body: Before-and-after video, seasonal house wash offers and retargeting site visitors before any cold audience gets a dollar.

cards.title: Business Profile support
cards.body: Your map ranking can't be bought, so we run your profile next to the ads instead of as a separate job.

cards.title: Tight service-area targeting
cards.body: Ad geography and Facebook radius stay inside the area your crews will drive, so spend doesn't drift across a metro.

cards.title: Conversion tracking
cards.body: The conversion action counts the lead you sell. With Housecall Pro, completed jobs and their revenue can flow back to Google Ads as offline conversions.

process.heading: How we build your ad account

steps.title: Audit before changes
steps.body: If you already run ads, we go through the account first and hand you the findings, whether or not you hire us.

steps.title: Split by service
steps.body: House washing, roof cleaning and flatwork each get their own ad group, so you can see which one books.

steps.title: Time spend to the season
steps.body: Budgets start from your invoices and call logs, then from tracked jobs by month once a season has run.

steps.title: Add Facebook second
steps.body: Once search is catching existing demand, Facebook retargeting and before-and-after video go live.

pricing.heading: Packages for pressure washing advertising
pricing.subhead: Paid media management is included from Growth up, and the Organic SEO behind your service pages is included from Foundation up. Ad spend stays separate.

faqs.question: Can I run Local Services Ads for pressure washing?
faqs.answer: Not with a category of its own. Google's US list had none on October 15, 2026, and Google presents the list as what's available "at this time." We keep checking; meanwhile Search Ads and your Business Profile do the work.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for pressure washing?
faqs.answer: Yes, for seasonal offers, before-and-after video and bringing back site visitors. Cold ads asking a stranger to book today rarely work for the trades, so Facebook goes in after search.

faqs.question: Can roof cleaning and house washing be advertised separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each gets its own ad group and ads, so you can see which one books jobs and move budget toward it.

faqs.question: How much should I spend on pressure washing ads?
faqs.answer: Work back from what a booked job is worth to you, repeat washes included. Spend goes directly to Google and Meta and stays separate from our management fee.

faqs.question: Will you change my conversion action to get faster results?
faqs.answer: No. Counting a page view or a phone-number click makes the dashboard look better and adds nothing to your schedule. We use geography, budget weighting, ad count and creative instead.

cta.heading: See where your ad spend goes
cta.body: Book a call and we'll go through your search terms, geography and conversion tracking with you. You'll leave with findings on where the spend went.
